\ Original Forth-only synthesis workload for task999. NOT a hardware emulator.
\ Loading only defines words: it does not open audio or play anything.
\ 4 voices; Q24 phase; fixed 48000 Hz mono signed16 little-endian output.
DECIMAL
48000 CONSTANT PS-RATE
16777216 CONSTANT PS-TURN
CREATE PS-KIND 4 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE PS-STEP 4 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE PS-GAIN 4 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE PS-DUTY 4 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE PS-PHASE 4 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE PS-NOISE 4 CELLS ALLOT
: PS-AT ( voice base -- addr ) SWAP CELLS + ;
: PS-VOICE? ( voice -- ) 0 4 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN ;
: PS-RESET ( -- )
  4 0 DO
    0 I PS-KIND PS-AT ! 0 I PS-STEP PS-AT !
    0 I PS-GAIN PS-AT ! 128 I PS-DUTY PS-AT !
    0 I PS-PHASE PS-AT ! 1 I PS-NOISE PS-AT !
  LOOP ;
\ Write (value voice register): 0 kind(0mute/1pulse/2triangle/3noise),
\ 1 Hz(0..23999), 2 peak gain(0..8191), 3 pulse duty(1..255 /256).
\ Validate all arguments before changing state; other fields/phase stay intact.
: PS-REG! ( value voice register -- )
  OVER PS-VOICE?
  DUP 0 4 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN
  DUP 0= IF DROP OVER 0 4 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN PS-KIND PS-AT ! EXIT THEN
  DUP 1 = IF DROP OVER 0 24000 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN
    SWAP PS-TURN * PS-RATE / SWAP PS-STEP PS-AT ! EXIT THEN
  DUP 2 = IF DROP OVER 0 8192 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN PS-GAIN PS-AT ! EXIT THEN
  DROP OVER 1 256 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN PS-DUTY PS-AT ! ;
: PS-LFSR ( u -- u ) DUP DUP 1 RSHIFT XOR 1 AND 15 LSHIFT SWAP 1 RSHIFT OR ;
: PS-VOICE ( voice -- sample )
  DUP PS-PHASE PS-AT @ OVER PS-STEP PS-AT @ +
  DUP PS-TURN >= IF
    OVER PS-NOISE PS-AT DUP @ PS-LFSR SWAP !
  THEN
  PS-TURN 1- AND DUP 2 PICK PS-PHASE PS-AT !
  OVER PS-KIND PS-AT @
  DUP 0= IF DROP 2DROP 0 EXIT THEN
  DUP 1 = IF DROP OVER PS-DUTY PS-AT @ 65536 * <
    IF PS-GAIN PS-AT @ ELSE PS-GAIN PS-AT @ NEGATE THEN EXIT THEN
  2 = IF
    14 RSHIFT DUP 512 < IF 128 * 32768 - ELSE 128 * 98304 SWAP - THEN
    SWAP PS-GAIN PS-AT @ * 32768 / EXIT THEN
  DROP DUP PS-NOISE PS-AT @ 1 AND IF PS-GAIN PS-AT @ ELSE PS-GAIN PS-AT @ NEGATE THEN ;
: PS-SAMPLE ( -- n ) 0 4 0 DO I PS-VOICE + LOOP ;
: PS-LE! ( n addr -- ) OVER 255 AND OVER C! SWAP 8 RSHIFT 255 AND SWAP 1+ C! ;
\ Caller supplies a valid destination of frames*2 bytes; no audio host needed.
: PS-RENDER ( addr frames -- ) DUP 0< IF -24 THROW THEN 0 ?DO PS-SAMPLE OVER PS-LE! 2 + LOOP DROP ;
: PS-DEMO-SETUP ( -- )
  PS-RESET
  1 0 0 PS-REG! 440 0 1 PS-REG! 2000 0 2 PS-REG! 64 0 3 PS-REG!
  1 1 0 PS-REG! 660 1 1 PS-REG! 2000 1 2 PS-REG!
  2 2 0 PS-REG! 110 2 1 PS-REG! 2000 2 2 PS-REG!
  3 3 0 PS-REG! 3000 3 1 PS-REG! 500 3 2 PS-REG! ;
PS-RESET

\ Source facts: docs/NES_APU_FORTH.md. DMC: docs/NES_DMC_FORTH.md. PAL/bus races/filtering excluded.

48000 CONSTANT NA-RATE
CREATE NA-STATE 44 CELLS ALLOT
\ Per channel: control,period,timer,sequence,length,env-start,env-div,decay,
\              sweep-register,sweep-divider,sweep-reload.
: NA@ ( channel field -- value ) SWAP 11 * + CELLS NA-STATE + @ ;
: NA! ( value channel field -- ) SWAP 11 * + CELLS NA-STATE + ! ;
CREATE NA-LENGTHS
10 , 254 , 20 , 2 , 40 , 4 , 80 , 6 , 160 , 8 , 60 , 10 , 14 , 12 , 26 , 14 ,
12 , 16 , 24 , 18 , 48 , 20 , 96 , 22 , 192 , 24 , 72 , 26 , 16 , 28 , 32 , 30 ,

4 , 8 , 16 , 32 , 64 , 96 , 128 , 160 , 202 , 254 , 380 , 508 , 762 , 1016 , 2034 , 4068 ,

VARIABLE NA-CYCLE VARIABLE NA-FRAME VARIABLE NA-MODE VARIABLE NA-INHIBIT
VARIABLE NA-IRQ VARIABLE NA-ENABLE VARIABLE NA-LINEAR VARIABLE NA-RELOAD
VARIABLE NA-LFSR VARIABLE NA-NOISE-MODE VARIABLE NA-RESET-AT VARIABLE NA-PENDING-MODE
VARIABLE NA-FRACTION VARIABLE NA-SLOW
CREATE NA-EVENTS 3072 CELLS ALLOT
VARIABLE NA-EVENT-COUNT VARIABLE NA-EVENT-INDEX
CREATE NA-DMC 15 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE NA-DMC-MEMORY 32768 ALLOT
CREATE NA-DMC-RATES
428 , 380 , 340 , 320 , 286 , 254 , 226 , 214 , 190 , 160 , 142 , 128 , 106 , 84 , 72 , 54 ,
\ DMC: ctrl,dac,start-reg,length-reg,period,timer,address,remaining,
\      buffer,full,shift,bits,silent,irq,fetch-count.
: ND@ ( field -- value ) CELLS NA-DMC + @ ;
: ND! ( value field -- ) CELLS NA-DMC + ! ;
: NA-MEM! { value address -- }
  value 0 256 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN
  address 32768 65536 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN
  value address 32768 - NA-DMC-MEMORY + C! ;
: NA-DMC-RESTART ( -- ) 2 ND@ 64 * 49152 + 6 ND! 3 ND@ 16 * 1+ 7 ND! ;
: NA-DMC-FETCH ( -- )
  9 ND@ 0= 7 ND@ 0> AND IF
    6 ND@ 32768 - NA-DMC-MEMORY + C@ 8 ND! 1 9 ND!
    6 ND@ 1+ DUP 65536 = IF DROP 32768 THEN 6 ND!
    7 ND@ 1- DUP 7 ND! 0= IF
      0 ND@ 64 AND IF NA-DMC-RESTART
      ELSE 0 ND@ 128 AND IF 1 13 ND! THEN THEN
    THEN
    14 ND@ 1+ 14 ND!
  THEN ;
: NA-DMC-OUTPUT ( -- )
  12 ND@ 0= IF
    10 ND@ 1 AND IF 1 ND@ 125 <= IF 1 ND@ 2 + 1 ND! THEN
    ELSE 1 ND@ 2 >= IF 1 ND@ 2 - 1 ND! THEN THEN
  THEN
  10 ND@ 1 RSHIFT 10 ND!
  11 ND@ 1- DUP 11 ND! 0= IF
    8 11 ND!
    9 ND@ IF 0 12 ND! 8 ND@ 10 ND! 0 9 ND!
    ELSE 1 12 ND! THEN
  THEN ;
\ Fast caller splits at each output clock, so at most one clock is due.
: NA-DMC-CLOCK { clocks -- }
  clocks 0= IF EXIT THEN
  clocks 5 ND@ <= IF 5 ND@ clocks - 5 ND!
  ELSE 4 ND@ 5 ND! NA-DMC-OUTPUT THEN ;
: NA-DMC-NEXT ( -- cpu-clocks ) 5 ND@ 1+ 2 * NA-CYCLE @ 1 AND - ;
: NA-RESET ( -- )
  NA-STATE 44 CELLS 0 FILL
  NA-DMC 15 CELLS 0 FILL 213 4 ND! 8 11 ND! 1 12 ND!
  0 NA-CYCLE ! 0 NA-FRAME ! 0 NA-MODE ! 0 NA-INHIBIT !
  0 NA-IRQ ! 0 NA-ENABLE ! 0 NA-LINEAR ! 0 NA-RELOAD !
  1 NA-LFSR ! 0 NA-NOISE-MODE ! 0 NA-RESET-AT ! 0 NA-PENDING-MODE !
  0 NA-FRACTION ! 0 NA-SLOW ! 1 3 1 NA!
  0 NA-EVENT-COUNT ! 0 NA-EVENT-INDEX ! ;
: NA-ENV { ch | ctl -- }
  ch 0 NA@ TO ctl
  ch 5 NA@ IF
    0 ch 5 NA! 15 ch 7 NA! ctl 15 AND ch 6 NA!
  ELSE
    ch 6 NA@ IF ch 6 NA@ 1- ch 6 NA!
    ELSE
      ctl 15 AND ch 6 NA!
      ch 7 NA@ IF ch 7 NA@ 1- ch 7 NA!
      ELSE ctl 32 AND IF 15 ch 7 NA! THEN THEN
    THEN
  THEN ;
: NA-QUARTER ( -- )
  0 NA-ENV 1 NA-ENV 3 NA-ENV
  NA-RELOAD @ IF 2 0 NA@ 127 AND NA-LINEAR !
  ELSE NA-LINEAR @ IF -1 NA-LINEAR +! THEN THEN
  2 0 NA@ 128 AND 0= IF 0 NA-RELOAD ! THEN ;
: NA-TARGET { ch | period sweep delta -- target }
  ch 1 NA@ TO period ch 8 NA@ TO sweep
  period sweep 7 AND RSHIFT TO delta
  sweep 8 AND IF period delta - ch 0= IF 1- THEN 0 MAX
  ELSE period delta + THEN ;
: NA-MUTED? ( ch -- flag ) DUP 1 NA@ 8 < SWAP NA-TARGET 2047 > OR ;
: NA-HALF { | halt ch sweep -- }
  4 0 DO
    I TO ch ch 2 = IF 128 ELSE 32 THEN TO halt
    ch 0 NA@ halt AND 0= ch 4 NA@ 0> AND IF ch 4 NA@ 1- ch 4 NA! THEN
  LOOP
  2 0 DO
    I TO ch ch 8 NA@ TO sweep
    ch 9 NA@ 0= sweep 128 AND 0<> AND sweep 7 AND 0<> AND
    ch NA-MUTED? 0= AND IF ch NA-TARGET ch 1 NA! THEN
    ch 9 NA@ 0= ch 10 NA@ OR IF
      sweep 4 RSHIFT 7 AND ch 9 NA! 0 ch 10 NA!
    ELSE ch 9 NA@ 1- ch 9 NA! THEN
  LOOP ;
: NA-NEXT-FRAME ( -- frame )
  NA-FRAME @ DUP 7457 < IF DROP 7457 EXIT THEN
  DUP 14913 < IF DROP 14913 EXIT THEN
  DUP 22371 < IF DROP 22371 EXIT THEN
  NA-MODE @ IF 37281 < IF 37281 ELSE 37282 THEN
  ELSE DUP 29828 < IF DROP 29828 EXIT THEN
    29829 < IF 29829 ELSE 29830 THEN THEN ;
: NA-FRAME-EVENT ( -- )
  NA-FRAME @ DUP 7457 = OVER 22371 = OR IF DROP NA-QUARTER EXIT THEN
  DUP 14913 = IF DROP NA-QUARTER NA-HALF EXIT THEN
  NA-MODE @ IF
    DUP 37281 = IF NA-QUARTER NA-HALF THEN
    37282 = IF 0 NA-FRAME ! THEN
  ELSE
    DUP 29828 >= IF NA-INHIBIT @ 0= IF 1 NA-IRQ ! THEN THEN
    DUP 29829 = IF NA-QUARTER NA-HALF THEN
    29830 = IF 0 NA-FRAME ! THEN
  THEN ;
: NA-FRAME-END ( -- )
  NA-RESET-AT @ DUP 0<> SWAP NA-CYCLE @ = AND IF
    0 NA-RESET-AT ! 0 NA-FRAME ! NA-PENDING-MODE @ NA-MODE !
    NA-MODE @ IF NA-QUARTER NA-HALF THEN
  ELSE NA-FRAME-EVENT THEN ;
: NA-NOISE-SHIFT ( -- )
  NA-LFSR @ DUP NA-NOISE-MODE @ IF 6 ELSE 1 THEN RSHIFT XOR 1 AND
  14 LSHIFT NA-LFSR @ 1 RSHIFT OR NA-LFSR ! ;
\ Batch a divider's input clocks; same zero->reload semantics as reference tick.
: NA-CLOCK { clocks ch | timer period events rest -- }
  clocks 0= IF EXIT THEN
  ch 2 NA@ TO timer ch 1 NA@ TO period
  clocks timer <= IF timer clocks - ch 2 NA! EXIT THEN
  clocks timer - 1- TO rest
  rest period 1+ / 1+ TO events
  period rest period 1+ MOD - ch 2 NA!
  ch 2 < IF ch 3 NA@ events + 7 AND ch 3 NA! EXIT THEN
  ch 2 = IF
    ch 4 NA@ 0<> NA-LINEAR @ 0<> AND IF ch 3 NA@ events + 31 AND ch 3 NA! THEN EXIT
  THEN
  events 0 ?DO NA-NOISE-SHIFT LOOP ;
: NA-TICK ( -- )
  1 NA-CYCLE +! NA-DMC-FETCH
  NA-CYCLE @ 1 AND 0= IF 1 0 NA-CLOCK 1 1 NA-CLOCK 1 3 NA-CLOCK 1 NA-DMC-CLOCK THEN
  1 2 NA-CLOCK
  1 NA-FRAME +! NA-FRAME-END ;
: NA-FAST { clocks | n pulses -- }
  BEGIN clocks 0> WHILE
    NA-NEXT-FRAME NA-FRAME @ - clocks MIN TO n
    NA-RESET-AT @ IF NA-RESET-AT @ NA-CYCLE @ - n MIN TO n THEN
    NA-DMC-NEXT n MIN TO n
    9 ND@ 0= 7 ND@ 0> AND IF 1 n MIN TO n THEN
    NA-CYCLE @ n + 2 / NA-CYCLE @ 2 / - TO pulses
    pulses 0 NA-CLOCK pulses 1 NA-CLOCK n 2 NA-CLOCK pulses 3 NA-CLOCK
    n NA-CYCLE +! NA-DMC-FETCH pulses NA-DMC-CLOCK
    n NA-FRAME +! n NEGATE +TO clocks NA-FRAME-END
  REPEAT ;
: NA-RAW-RUN ( clocks -- )
  DUP 0< IF -24 THROW THEN
  DUP 9223372036854775807 NA-CYCLE @ - > IF -24 THROW THEN
  NA-SLOW @ IF 0 ?DO NA-TICK LOOP ELSE NA-FAST THEN ;
: NA-RAW-TO ( cycle -- ) DUP NA-CYCLE @ < IF -24 THROW THEN NA-CYCLE @ - NA-RAW-RUN ;
: NA-LOAD-LENGTH { value ch -- }
  NA-ENABLE @ 1 ch LSHIFT AND IF value 3 RSHIFT CELLS NA-LENGTHS + @ ch 4 NA! THEN ;
: NA-PERIOD-LOW { value ch -- } ch 1 NA@ 1792 AND value OR ch 1 NA! ;
: NA-PERIOD-HIGH { value ch -- } ch 1 NA@ 255 AND value 7 AND 8 LSHIFT OR ch 1 NA! ;
: NA-CHECK-WRITE { value address cycle -- }
  value 0 256 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN
  address 16384 16408 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN
  cycle NA-CYCLE @ < IF -24 THROW THEN
  address 16404 = address 16406 = OR IF -24 THROW THEN
  address 16407 = cycle 9223372036854775803 > AND IF -24 THROW THEN
  ;
: NA-STORE { value address | ch reg -- }
  address 16405 = IF
    value 31 AND NA-ENABLE !
    0 13 ND!
    value 16 AND IF 7 ND@ 0= IF NA-DMC-RESTART THEN ELSE 0 7 ND! THEN
    4 0 DO value 1 I LSHIFT AND 0= IF 0 I 4 NA! THEN LOOP EXIT THEN
  address 16400 16404 WITHIN IF
    address 16400 - CASE
      0 OF value 0 ND! value 15 AND CELLS NA-DMC-RATES + @ 2 / 1- 4 ND!
        value 128 AND 0= IF 0 13 ND! THEN ENDOF
      1 OF value 127 AND 1 ND! ENDOF
      2 OF value 2 ND! ENDOF
      3 OF value 3 ND! ENDOF
    ENDCASE EXIT THEN
  address 16407 = IF
    value 64 AND NA-INHIBIT ! NA-INHIBIT @ IF 0 NA-IRQ ! THEN
    value 128 AND NA-PENDING-MODE !
    NA-CYCLE @ DUP 1 AND IF 4 ELSE 3 THEN + NA-RESET-AT ! EXIT THEN
  address 16384 - 4 / TO ch address 3 AND TO reg
  ch 2 < IF
    reg CASE
      0 OF value ch 0 NA! ENDOF
      1 OF value ch 8 NA! 1 ch 10 NA! ENDOF
      2 OF value ch NA-PERIOD-LOW ENDOF
      3 OF value ch NA-PERIOD-HIGH value ch NA-LOAD-LENGTH
        0 ch 3 NA! 1 ch 5 NA! ENDOF
    ENDCASE EXIT THEN
  ch 2 = IF
    reg CASE
      0 OF value ch 0 NA! ENDOF
      2 OF value ch NA-PERIOD-LOW ENDOF
      3 OF value ch NA-PERIOD-HIGH value ch NA-LOAD-LENGTH 1 NA-RELOAD ! ENDOF
    ENDCASE EXIT THEN
  reg CASE
    0 OF value 3 0 NA! ENDOF
    2 OF value 128 AND NA-NOISE-MODE !
      value 15 AND CELLS NA-NOISE-PERIODS + @ 2 / 1- 3 1 NA! ENDOF
    3 OF value 3 NA-LOAD-LENGTH 1 3 5 NA! ENDOF
  ENDCASE ;
\ Reclaim consumed entries only after all admission checks have succeeded.
: NA-COMPACT ( -- )
  NA-EVENT-INDEX @ 3 * CELLS NA-EVENTS + NA-EVENTS
  NA-EVENT-COUNT @ NA-EVENT-INDEX @ - 3 * CELLS MOVE
  NA-EVENT-INDEX @ NEGATE NA-EVENT-COUNT +! 0 NA-EVENT-INDEX ! ;
: NA-EVENT! { value address cycle | entry -- }
  value address cycle NA-CHECK-WRITE
  NA-EVENT-COUNT @ NA-EVENT-INDEX @ - 1024 >= IF -528 THROW THEN
  NA-EVENT-COUNT @ IF
    NA-EVENT-COUNT @ 1- 3 * 2 + CELLS NA-EVENTS + @ cycle > IF -24 THROW THEN
  THEN
  NA-EVENT-COUNT @ 1024 >= IF NA-COMPACT THEN
  NA-EVENT-COUNT @ 3 * CELLS NA-EVENTS + TO entry
  value entry ! address entry CELL+ ! cycle entry 2 CELLS + !
  1 NA-EVENT-COUNT +! ;
: NA-TO { cycle | entry at -- }
  cycle NA-CYCLE @ < IF -24 THROW THEN
  BEGIN NA-EVENT-INDEX @ NA-EVENT-COUNT @ < WHILE
    NA-EVENT-INDEX @ 3 * CELLS NA-EVENTS + TO entry
    entry 2 CELLS + @ TO at
    at cycle > IF cycle NA-RAW-TO EXIT THEN
    at NA-RAW-TO entry @ entry CELL+ @ NA-STORE 1 NA-EVENT-INDEX +!
  REPEAT cycle NA-RAW-TO ;
: NA-RUN ( clocks -- )
  DUP 0< IF -24 THROW THEN
  DUP 9223372036854775807 NA-CYCLE @ - > IF -24 THROW THEN
  NA-CYCLE @ + NA-TO ;
: NA-WRITE { value address cycle -- }
  value address cycle NA-CHECK-WRITE cycle NA-TO value address NA-STORE ;
: NA-IRQ? ( -- flag ) NA-IRQ @ 13 ND@ OR 0<> ;
: NA-STATUS ( cycle -- status )
  NA-TO 0 4 0 DO I 4 NA@ IF 1 I LSHIFT OR THEN LOOP
  7 ND@ IF 16 OR THEN 13 ND@ IF 128 OR THEN
  NA-IRQ @ IF 64 OR THEN 0 NA-IRQ ! ;
: NA-VOLUME ( ch -- volume ) DUP 0 NA@ DUP 16 AND IF 15 AND NIP ELSE DROP 7 NA@ THEN ;
: NA-PULSE { ch -- level }

  ch 0 NA@ 6 RSHIFT CELLS NA-DUTIES + @ ch 3 NA@ RSHIFT 1 AND
  IF ch NA-VOLUME ELSE 0 THEN ;
: NA-TRIANGLE ( -- level ) 2 3 NA@ DUP 16 < IF 15 SWAP - ELSE 16 - THEN ;
: NA-NOISE ( -- level ) 3 4 NA@ 0= NA-LFSR @ 1 AND OR IF 0 ELSE 3 NA-VOLUME THEN ;
\ Exact rational evaluation of the documented approximate DAC equations, including DMC.
\ Output = floor(pulse*32767) + floor(tnd*32767), using wide rational LUTs.
\ Unipolar; no analog filters or DC removal.
CREATE NA-PULSE-MIX 31 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE NA-TND-MIX 32768 CELLS ALLOT
: NA-INIT-MIX ( -- )

  32768 0 DO
    I 2048 / 12241 * 22638 * I 128 / 15 AND 8227 * 22638 * +
    I 127 AND 8227 * 12241 * +
    DUP 15979 * 32767 UM* ROT 100 * 8227 12241 * 22638 * + 100 * UM/MOD NIP
    I CELLS NA-TND-MIX + !
  LOOP ;
: NA-SAMPLE ( -- s16 )

  NA-TRIANGLE 16 * NA-NOISE + 128 * 1 ND@ + CELLS NA-TND-MIX + @ + 32767 MIN ;

: NA-LE! ( n addr -- ) OVER 255 AND OVER C! SWAP 8 RSHIFT 255 AND SWAP 1+ C! ;
: NA-RENDER ( addr frames -- )
  DUP 0< IF -24 THROW THEN
  0 ?DO
    NA-FRACTION @ NA-CPU + NA-RATE /MOD NA-RUN NA-FRACTION !
    NA-SAMPLE OVER NA-LE! 2 +
  LOOP DROP ;
: NA-DEMO-SETUP ( -- )

  15 16405 0 NA-WRITE
  191 16384 0 NA-WRITE 8 16385 0 NA-WRITE 253 16386 0 NA-WRITE 8 16387 0 NA-WRITE
  115 16388 0 NA-WRITE 8 16389 0 NA-WRITE 167 16390 0 NA-WRITE 8 16391 0 NA-WRITE
  255 16392 0 NA-WRITE 253 16394 0 NA-WRITE 8 16395 0 NA-WRITE
  56 16396 0 NA-WRITE 132 16398 0 NA-WRITE 8 16399 0 NA-WRITE ;

\ Original PAL SID register model. Not 6581/8580 analog or ROM compatibility.
\ Load from repository root; loading alone never opens audio.
S" examples/sid-filter-coeffs.fs" INCLUDED
DECIMAL
985248 CONSTANT SI-CPU
48000 CONSTANT SI-RATE
16777215 CONSTANT SI-MASK
CREATE SI-REGS 25 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE SI-STATE 30 CELLS ALLOT
\ Per voice: phase,lfsr,envelope,stage(0attack/1decay/2release),rate-counter,
\            exp-counter,hold-zero,frequency,width,exp-period.
: SI@ ( voice field -- n ) SWAP 10 * + CELLS SI-STATE + @ ;
: SI! ( value voice field -- ) SWAP 10 * + CELLS SI-STATE + ! ;
: SI-R@ ( offset -- n ) CELLS SI-REGS + @ ;
: SI-CONTROL ( voice -- n ) 7 * 4 + SI-R@ ;
CREATE SI-RATES 9 , 32 , 63 , 95 , 149 , 220 , 267 , 313 , 392 , 977 , 1954 , 3126 , 3907 , 11720 , 19532 , 31251 ,
CREATE SI-NOISE-TAPS 22 , 20 , 16 , 13 , 11 , 7 , 4 , 2 ,
CREATE SI-RISE 3 CELLS ALLOT
VARIABLE SI-CYCLE VARIABLE SI-FRACTION VARIABLE SI-SLOW
VARIABLE SI-LOW VARIABLE SI-BAND
VARIABLE SI-CLIPS VARIABLE SI-FILTER-LIMITS
CREATE SI-EVENTS 3072 CELLS ALLOT
VARIABLE SI-EVENT-COUNT VARIABLE SI-EVENT-INDEX
: SI-RESET ( -- )
  SI-REGS 25 CELLS 0 FILL SI-STATE 30 CELLS 0 FILL
  3 0 DO 8388600 I 1 SI! 2 I 3 SI! 1 I 6 SI! 1 I 9 SI! LOOP
  SI-RISE 3 CELLS 0 FILL
  0 SI-CYCLE ! 0 SI-FRACTION ! 0 SI-SLOW ! 0 SI-LOW ! 0 SI-BAND !
  0 SI-EVENT-COUNT ! 0 SI-EVENT-INDEX ! 0 SI-CLIPS ! 0 SI-FILTER-LIMITS ! ;
: SI-ENV-RATE ( voice -- clocks )
  DUP 3 SI@ CASE
    0 OF 7 * 5 + SI-R@ 4 RSHIFT ENDOF
    1 OF 7 * 5 + SI-R@ 15 AND ENDOF
    2 OF 7 * 6 + SI-R@ 15 AND ENDOF
  ENDCASE CELLS SI-RATES + @ ;
: SI-EXP-UPDATE { voice | level -- }
  voice 2 SI@ TO level
  level CASE
    255 OF 1 voice 9 SI! ENDOF 93 OF 2 voice 9 SI! ENDOF
    54 OF 4 voice 9 SI! ENDOF 26 OF 8 voice 9 SI! ENDOF
    14 OF 16 voice 9 SI! ENDOF 6 OF 30 voice 9 SI! ENDOF
    0 OF 1 voice 9 SI! ENDOF
  ENDCASE ;
: SI-ENV { voice | level stage sustain exp -- }
  voice 2 SI@ TO level voice 3 SI@ TO stage
  stage 0= IF
    0 voice 5 SI! level 255 < IF level 1+ TO level THEN
    level voice 2 SI! voice SI-EXP-UPDATE level 255 = IF 1 voice 3 SI! THEN EXIT
  THEN
  voice 5 SI@ 1+ TO exp
  exp voice 9 SI@ >= IF
    0 voice 5 SI!
    voice 6 SI@ 0= IF
      voice 7 * 6 + SI-R@ 4 RSHIFT 17 * TO sustain
      stage 2 = level sustain > OR IF
        level 0> IF level 1- DUP voice 2 SI! 0= IF 1 voice 6 SI! THEN voice SI-EXP-UPDATE THEN
      THEN
    THEN
  ELSE exp voice 5 SI! THEN ;
: SI-NOISE-SHIFT ( voice -- )
  DUP 1 SI@ DUP 22 RSHIFT OVER 17 RSHIFT XOR 1 AND
  SWAP 1 LSHIFT OR 8388607 AND SWAP 1 SI! ;
: SI-PHASES { clocks | voice old raw fresh -- }
  3 0 DO
    I TO voice voice 0 SI@ TO old
    voice SI-CONTROL 8 AND IF 0 TO raw
    ELSE old clocks voice 7 SI@ * + TO raw THEN
    raw SI-MASK AND TO fresh
    fresh voice 0 SI!
    old 8388608 + 24 RSHIFT raw 8388608 + 24 RSHIFT < SI-RISE I CELLS + !
    old 524288 + 20 RSHIFT raw 524288 + 20 RSHIFT < IF voice SI-NOISE-SHIFT THEN
  LOOP
  3 0 DO
    I SI-CONTROL 2 AND SI-RISE I 2 + 3 MOD CELLS + @ AND IF 0 I 0 SI! THEN
  LOOP ;
: SI-COUNTERS { clocks | voice count -- }
  3 0 DO
    I TO voice voice 4 SI@ clocks + 32767 AND TO count
    count voice 4 SI! count voice SI-ENV-RATE = IF 0 voice 4 SI! voice SI-ENV THEN
  LOOP ;
: SI-TICK ( -- ) 1 SI-PHASES 1 SI-COUNTERS 1 SI-CYCLE +! ;
: SI-EDGE { phase frequency half | pos distance -- clocks }
  phase half 2 * MOD TO pos
  pos half < IF half pos - ELSE half 3 * pos - THEN TO distance
  distance frequency 1- + frequency / ;
: SI-STEP-LIMIT { clocks | voice count distance frequency phase -- n }
  3 0 DO
    I TO voice voice 4 SI@ TO count
    voice SI-ENV-RATE count - 32767 AND DUP 0= IF DROP 32768 THEN
    clocks MIN TO clocks
    voice 7 SI@ TO frequency voice 0 SI@ TO phase
    frequency voice SI-CONTROL 8 AND 0= AND IF
      phase frequency 524288 SI-EDGE clocks MIN TO clocks
      phase frequency 8388608 SI-EDGE clocks MIN TO clocks
    THEN
  LOOP clocks ;
: SI-FAST { clocks | n -- }
  BEGIN clocks 0> WHILE
    clocks SI-STEP-LIMIT TO n n SI-PHASES n SI-COUNTERS n SI-CYCLE +!
    n NEGATE +TO clocks
  REPEAT ;
: SI-RAW-RUN ( clocks -- )
  DUP 0< IF -24 THROW THEN
  DUP 9223372036854775807 SI-CYCLE @ - > IF -24 THROW THEN
  SI-SLOW @ IF 0 ?DO SI-TICK LOOP ELSE SI-FAST THEN ;
: SI-RAW-TO ( cycle -- ) DUP SI-CYCLE @ < IF -24 THROW THEN SI-CYCLE @ - SI-RAW-RUN ;
: SI-CHECK-WRITE { value address cycle | waveform -- }
  value 0 256 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN
  address 54272 54297 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN
  cycle SI-CYCLE @ < IF -24 THROW THEN
  address 54272 - DUP 21 < SWAP 7 MOD 4 = AND IF
    value 240 AND TO waveform waveform waveform 1- AND IF -21 THROW THEN
  THEN ;
: SI-STORE { value address | offset voice field old -- }
  address 54272 - TO offset offset 25 >= IF EXIT THEN
  offset 21 < IF
    offset 7 / TO voice offset 7 MOD TO field
    field 3 = IF value 15 AND TO value THEN
    field 4 = IF
      voice SI-CONTROL TO old
      old value XOR 1 AND IF
        value 1 AND IF 0 voice 3 SI! 0 voice 6 SI! ELSE 2 voice 3 SI! THEN
      THEN

\ Original declared Paula register model; no Agnus bus/ROM/analog fidelity.
\ Register addresses are custom-chip offsets. Loading never opens audio.
DECIMAL
3546895 CONSTANT PA-CPU
48000 CONSTANT PA-RATE
CREATE PA-MEMORY 524288 ALLOT PA-MEMORY 524288 0 FILL
CREATE PA-REGS 24 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE PA-STATE 56 CELLS ALLOT
\ ptr,remaining,timer,mode(0idle1DMA2manual),phase,word,sample,period,volume,first,attach-phase,fetches,pending-word,pending-valid
: PA@ ( voice field -- n ) SWAP 14 * + CELLS PA-STATE + @ ;
: PA! ( value voice field -- ) SWAP 14 * + CELLS PA-STATE + ! ;
: PA-R@ ( voice field -- n ) SWAP 6 * + CELLS PA-REGS + @ ;
: PA-R! ( value voice field -- ) SWAP 6 * + CELLS PA-REGS + ! ;
VARIABLE PA-DMA VARIABLE PA-ADK VARIABLE PA-INTENA VARIABLE PA-INTREQ
VARIABLE PA-CYCLE VARIABLE PA-FRACTION VARIABLE PA-SLOW VARIABLE PA-PER-CLAMPS
CREATE PA-DUE 4 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE PA-EVENTS 3072 CELLS ALLOT
VARIABLE PA-EVENT-COUNT VARIABLE PA-EVENT-INDEX
: PA-RESET ( -- )
  PA-REGS 24 CELLS 0 FILL PA-STATE 56 CELLS 0 FILL PA-DUE 4 CELLS 0 FILL
  4 0 DO 65536 I 7 PA! LOOP
  0 PA-DMA ! 0 PA-ADK ! 0 PA-INTENA ! 0 PA-INTREQ !
  0 PA-CYCLE ! 0 PA-FRACTION ! 0 PA-SLOW ! 0 PA-PER-CLAMPS !
  0 PA-EVENT-COUNT ! 0 PA-EVENT-INDEX ! ;
: PA-MEM! { byte address -- }
  byte 0 256 WITHIN address 0 524288 WITHIN AND 0= IF -24 THROW THEN
  byte PA-MEMORY address + C! ;
: PA-PERIOD ( word -- ticks ) DUP 0= IF DROP 65536 THEN ;
: PA-VOLUME ( word -- volume ) DUP 64 AND IF DROP 64 ELSE 63 AND THEN ;
: PA-LENGTH ( voice -- words ) 2 PA-R@ DUP 0= IF DROP 65536 THEN ;
: PA-LOCATION ( voice -- address ) DUP 0 PA-R@ 16 LSHIFT SWAP 1 PA-R@ OR ;
: PA-IRQ ( voice -- ) 128 SWAP LSHIFT PA-INTREQ @ OR PA-INTREQ ! ;
: PA-IRQ? ( -- flag ) PA-INTENA @ 16384 AND 0<> PA-INTENA @ PA-INTREQ @ AND 1920 AND 0<> AND ;
: PA-ENABLED ( voice -- flag ) 1 SWAP LSHIFT PA-DMA @ AND 0<> PA-DMA @ 512 AND 0<> AND ;
: PA-RELOAD ( voice -- ) DUP PA-LOCATION OVER 0 PA! DUP PA-LENGTH OVER 1 PA! 0 SWAP 10 PA! ;
: PA-START ( voice -- )
  DUP PA-RELOAD 1 OVER 2 PA! 1 OVER 3 PA! 0 OVER 4 PA! 1 OVER 9 PA! 0 SWAP 13 PA! ;
: PA-ATTACH { voice word | av ap target -- }
  PA-ADK @ 1 voice LSHIFT AND 0<> TO av
  PA-ADK @ 16 voice LSHIFT AND 0<> TO ap
  voice 3 = av ap OR 0= OR IF EXIT THEN
  voice 1+ TO target
  av ap AND IF
    voice 10 PA@ IF FALSE TO av ELSE FALSE TO ap THEN
    voice 10 PA@ 1 XOR voice 10 PA!
  THEN
  av IF word PA-VOLUME target 8 PA! THEN
  ap IF
    word PA-PERIOD DUP 123 < IF DROP 123 1 PA-PER-CLAMPS +! THEN
    target 7 PA!
  THEN ;
: PA-FETCH { voice | address word -- }
  voice 0 PA@ TO address
  PA-MEMORY address + C@ 8 LSHIFT PA-MEMORY address 1+ 524287 AND + C@ OR TO word
  word voice 5 PA! word voice 5 PA-R!
  address 2 + 524287 AND voice 0 PA!
  voice 11 PA@ 1+ voice 11 PA!
  voice word PA-ATTACH
  voice 9 PA@ IF voice PA-IRQ 0 voice 9 PA! THEN
  voice 1 PA@ 1- DUP voice 1 PA! 0= IF voice PA-RELOAD voice PA-IRQ THEN ;
: PA-SIGNED ( byte -- sample ) DUP 128 AND IF 256 - THEN ;
: PA-TRANSITION { voice | phase mode -- }
  voice 4 PA@ TO phase voice 3 PA@ TO mode
  mode 0= IF EXIT THEN
  phase 0= IF
    mode 1 = IF voice PA-FETCH ELSE
      voice 12 PA@ voice 5 PA! 0 voice 13 PA!
      voice 11 PA@ 1+ voice 11 PA! voice voice 5 PA@ PA-ATTACH
    THEN
    voice 5 PA@ 8 RSHIFT PA-SIGNED voice 6 PA! 1 voice 4 PA!
  ELSE phase 1 = IF
    voice 5 PA@ 255 AND PA-SIGNED voice 6 PA!
    mode 1 = IF 0 ELSE 2 THEN voice 4 PA!
  ELSE
    voice PA-IRQ
    voice 13 PA@ IF 0 voice 4 PA! voice RECURSE
    ELSE 0 voice 3 PA! 0 voice 2 PA! THEN EXIT
  THEN THEN
  voice 7 PA@ voice 2 PA! ;
: PA-ADVANCE { ticks -- }
  4 0 DO
    I 3 PA@ IF I 2 PA@ ticks - DUP I 2 PA! 0= ELSE FALSE THEN
    PA-DUE I CELLS + !
  LOOP
  4 0 DO PA-DUE I CELLS + @ IF I PA-TRANSITION THEN LOOP
  ticks PA-CYCLE +! ;
: PA-STEP-LIMIT ( ticks -- n ) 4 0 DO I 3 PA@ IF I 2 PA@ MIN THEN LOOP ;
: PA-RAW-RUN { ticks | n -- }
  ticks 0< ticks 9223372036854775807 PA-CYCLE @ - > OR IF -24 THROW THEN
  BEGIN ticks 0> WHILE
    PA-SLOW @ IF 1 ELSE ticks PA-STEP-LIMIT THEN TO n
    n PA-ADVANCE n NEGATE +TO ticks
  REPEAT ;
: PA-RAW-TO ( tick -- ) DUP PA-CYCLE @ < IF -24 THROW THEN PA-CYCLE @ - PA-RAW-RUN ;
: PA-AUDIO-REG? ( offset -- flag ) DUP 160 220 WITHIN SWAP 15 AND 12 < AND ;
: PA-CHECK { value address tick | mask -- }
  value 0 65536 WITHIN address 0 512 WITHIN AND address 1 AND 0= AND 0= IF -24 THROW THEN
  tick PA-CYCLE @ < IF -24 THROW THEN
  address PA-AUDIO-REG? IF
    address 15 AND 6 = IF value 0> value 123 < AND IF -21 THROW THEN THEN EXIT
  THEN
  address CASE
    150 OF 527 ENDOF 158 OF 255 ENDOF 154 OF 18304 ENDOF 156 OF 1920 ENDOF
    -24 THROW
  ENDCASE TO mask
  value 32767 AND mask INVERT AND IF -21 THROW THEN ;
: PA-BITS ( value old -- new ) OVER 32768 AND IF OR 32767 AND ELSE SWAP INVERT AND THEN ;
: PA-STORE { value address | voice field old was now -- }
  address PA-AUDIO-REG? IF
    address 160 - 4 RSHIFT TO voice address 15 AND 2 / TO field
    field CASE
      0 OF value 7 AND TO value ENDOF
      1 OF value 65534 AND TO value ENDOF
      3 OF value PA-PERIOD voice 7 PA! ENDOF
      4 OF value PA-VOLUME voice 8 PA! ENDOF
    ENDCASE
    value voice field PA-R!
    field 5 = voice PA-ENABLED 0= AND IF
      value voice 12 PA! 1 voice 13 PA!
      voice 3 PA@ 2 <> IF
        2 voice 3 PA! 0 voice 4 PA! 1 voice 2 PA! 0 voice 10 PA!
      THEN
    THEN EXIT
  THEN
  address CASE
    150 OF
      PA-DMA @ TO old value old PA-BITS PA-DMA !
      4 0 DO
        old 512 AND 0<> old 1 I LSHIFT AND 0<> AND TO was
        I PA-ENABLED TO now
        now was 0= AND IF I PA-START THEN
        was now 0= AND IF 0 I 3 PA! 0 I 2 PA! THEN
      LOOP
    ENDOF
    158 OF value PA-ADK @ PA-BITS PA-ADK ! ENDOF
    154 OF value PA-INTENA @ PA-BITS PA-INTENA ! ENDOF
    156 OF value PA-INTREQ @ PA-BITS PA-INTREQ ! ENDOF
  ENDCASE ;
: PA-COMPACT ( -- )
  PA-EVENT-INDEX @ 3 * CELLS PA-EVENTS + PA-EVENTS
  PA-EVENT-COUNT @ PA-EVENT-INDEX @ - 3 * CELLS MOVE
  PA-EVENT-INDEX @ NEGATE PA-EVENT-COUNT +! 0 PA-EVENT-INDEX ! ;
: PA-EVENT! { value address tick | entry -- }
  value address tick PA-CHECK
  PA-EVENT-COUNT @ PA-EVENT-INDEX @ - 1024 >= IF -528 THROW THEN
  PA-EVENT-COUNT @ IF PA-EVENT-COUNT @ 1- 3 * 2 + CELLS PA-EVENTS + @ tick > IF -24 THROW THEN THEN
  PA-EVENT-COUNT @ 1024 >= IF PA-COMPACT THEN
  PA-EVENT-COUNT @ 3 * CELLS PA-EVENTS + TO entry
  value entry ! address entry CELL+ ! tick entry 2 CELLS + ! 1 PA-EVENT-COUNT +! ;
: PA-TO { tick | entry at -- }
  tick PA-CYCLE @ < IF -24 THROW THEN
  BEGIN PA-EVENT-INDEX @ PA-EVENT-COUNT @ < WHILE
    PA-EVENT-INDEX @ 3 * CELLS PA-EVENTS + TO entry entry 2 CELLS + @ TO at
    at tick > IF tick PA-RAW-TO EXIT THEN
    at PA-RAW-TO entry @ entry CELL+ @ PA-STORE 1 PA-EVENT-INDEX +!
  REPEAT tick PA-RAW-TO ;
: PA-WRITE { value address tick -- } value address tick PA-CHECK tick PA-TO value address PA-STORE ;
: PA-RUN ( ticks -- )
  DUP 0< IF -24 THROW THEN DUP 9223372036854775807 PA-CYCLE @ - > IF -24 THROW THEN PA-CYCLE @ + PA-TO ;
: PA-READ { address tick -- word }
  address 0 512 WITHIN address 1 AND 0= AND 0= IF -24 THROW THEN
  tick PA-CYCLE @ < IF -24 THROW THEN
  address 2 = address 16 = OR address 28 = OR address 30 = OR 0= IF -21 THROW THEN
  tick PA-TO address CASE
    2 OF PA-DMA @ ENDOF 16 OF PA-ADK @ ENDOF 28 OF PA-INTENA @ ENDOF 30 OF PA-INTREQ @ ENDOF
  ENDCASE ;
: PA-SAMPLE { | left right value -- left right }
  0 TO left 0 TO right
  4 0 DO
    PA-ADK @ 17 I LSHIFT AND 0= IF
      I 6 PA@ I 8 PA@ * 2 * TO value
      I 0= I 3 = OR IF left value + TO left ELSE right value + TO right THEN
    THEN
  LOOP left right ;
: PA-LE! ( n address -- ) OVER 255 AND OVER C! SWAP 8 RSHIFT 255 AND SWAP 1+ C! ;
: PA-RENDER { address frames -- }
  frames 0< IF -24 THROW THEN
  frames 0 ?DO
    PA-FRACTION @ PA-CPU + PA-RATE /MOD PA-RUN PA-FRACTION !
    PA-SAMPLE address 2 + PA-LE! address PA-LE! address 4 + TO address
  LOOP ;
: PA-DEMO-MEMORY ( -- ) 1024 0 DO I 37 * 11 + 255 AND I PA-MEM! LOOP ;
: PA-DEMO-SETUP ( -- )

    I 128 * I 16 * 162 + 0 PA-WRITE 32 I 16 * 164 + 0 PA-WRITE
    I 107 * 214 + I 16 * 166 + 0 PA-WRITE 32 I 16 * 168 + 0 PA-WRITE
  LOOP 33295 150 0 PA-WRITE ;
